name: meetlite

scripts.build:backend: npm run build --workspace=@minimeet/shared && npm run build --workspace=@minimeet/api-gateway && npm run build --workspace=@minimeet/auth-service && npm run build --workspace=@minimeet/room-service && npm run build --workspace=@minimeet/mediasoup-service && npm run build --workspace=@minimeet/edge-room-coordinator
scripts.typecheck:backend: npm run typecheck --workspace=@minimeet/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@minimeet/api-gateway && npm run typecheck --workspace=@minimeet/auth-service && npm run typecheck --workspace=@minimeet/room-service && npm run typecheck --workspace=@minimeet/mediasoup-service && npm run typecheck --workspace=@minimeet/edge-room-coordinator
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run build:client

description: A real-time video conferencing application with multiple services
